description: qsltdupdater is a tool to update qsltdupdater.
name: qsltdupdater

scripts.build:egui:qsm.bak: python scripts/pybuild.py egui --name "聚合音乐" --app-name qsm --manifest-url https://qsc.cdn.qcsm.ltd/update/qsm/version_2.json --manifest-url https://qsw.us.ci/update/qsm/version.json --homepage https://qsm.us.ci --template F --retry-times 5 --max-versions 3 --service QsmServer
scripts.qsm:release: python scripts/pybuild.py egui --name "聚合音乐" --app-name qsm --manifest-url https://qsc.cdn.qcsm.ltd/update/qsm/version_2.json --manifest-url https://qsw.us.ci/update/qsm/version.json --homepage https://qsm.us.ci --template F --retry-times 5 --max-versions 3 --service QsmServer
